title: Introduce temporal-tenure model versioning and changelog curation autosynth
author: Maya Patel
description: Context: onboarding churn and noisy changelogs are making it hard for downstream teams to interpret model upgrades and for the registry to retain only actionable performance profiles. This PR introduces a temporal-tenure concept (tenure score + decay) for model versions and an autosynth changelog curator that drafts compact release notes by prioritizing stable signals. Goals: 1) make model version history size-bounded and preference-aware, 2) automatically synthesize concise changelog bullets focused on perf regressions/improvements and metadata drift, 3) attach a retention/archival policy for performance profiles tied to tenure. What I changed (high level): - Add tenure scoring engine (registry/onboard/tenure.py) to compute a decayed stability score for each model variant based on traffic, eval baseline pass rate, and time-since-onboard. - Introduce profile-decay heuristics (profiles/decay_score.go) and a retention policy that marks low-tenure profiles for cold storage. - Add autosynth curation service (registry/changelog/autosynth.py) that consumes tenure signals + perf deltas and drafts 1-3 sentence release snippets. - Wire the curator into the existing release pipeline: release-assembler now calls autosynth for non-enterprise auto-drafts and stores the curated blurb in manifest.metadata.changelog_snippet. - Add an opt-out tag for customers and an API flag (onboard.v1:retain=false) to pin versions regardless of tenure. - Add docs and migration guide (docs/onboarding/temporal-tenure.md) and unit/integration tests. Motivation and tradeoffs: tenure reduces noise and storage costs but can surface risk if teams rely on cached perf profiles; that risk is mitigated by the pin/retain API and 30-day grace window before cold-archival. The autosynth aims for high precision over recall — it will only include changes with signal above a configurable threshold to avoid noisy autogenerated prose. Checklist: - [x] tenure scoring algorithm implemented + tests - [x] autosynth draft generator implemented + e2e integration test - [x] migration guide and docs - [x] telemetry: added tenure_histogram and autosynth_accept_rate metrics - [x] feature-flagged rollout (default on for non-enterprise orgs) Backwards compatibility: existing manifests gain a new optional field changelog_snippet; clients ignore it if absent. Performance impact: small CPU overhead in the release pipeline; profile decay runs as a daily background job. Related: ENG-8234 (tenure scoring), PM-1198 (changelog UX), SUP-5421 (customer request to auto-summarize).

release_notes: Added temporal-tenure versioning to manage model history size and signal-driven changelog autosynthesis. New optional manifest field 'changelog_snippet' contains concise, autogenerated release notes when available. Retention policy for performance profiles introduced; low-tenure profiles are cold-archived after a configurable grace window. Added feature flag and opt-out API for enterprise customers.
